title: cynoglossum gymnandrum
intro: Cynoglossum gymnandrum, commonly known as Chinese forget-me-not or Hairy Vervain, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits which may include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum gymnandrum include reducing fever, relieving cough and respiratory congestion, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, but it is known to contain saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
